preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly two lines: first line is an integer L (1 ≤ L ≤ 200000), second line is a string of length L with lowercase English letters.
The integer L on the first line matches the length of the string on the second line.
The string on the second line consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == max((len(s) for s in set(stdin.splitlines()[1][i:j] for i in range(len(stdin.splitlines()[1])) for j in range(i+1, len(stdin.splitlines()[1])+1)) if list(stdin.splitlines()[1]).count(s) >= 2), default=0)
postconditions.description: The output is the length of the longest substring that appears at least twice in the input string. If no such substring exists, the output is zero.
